cohort: The study participants were women who had undergone a total laparoscopic hysterectomy (TLH) between 2014 and 2020.
finding: Women with a previous cesarean section undergoing total laparoscopic hysterectomy experienced significantly longer surgery duration, greater estimated blood loss, and more additional postoperative endoscopic interventions compared to those without a history of CS, although major complication rates were not significantly higher.
mod_finding: A previous cesarean section was associated with significantly longer surgery duration, greater estimated blood loss, and more additional postoperative endoscopic interventions during total laparoscopic hysterectomy.
